en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a lively street scene in a historic European city. On the right are ornate multi‑storey buildings with elaborate facades; at the end of the street stands a large domed building in a square, with hills visible in the distance. People, buses and a tram are in the foreground, suggesting an active urban centre. Below the image is the printed caption in Hungarian, and the reverse side has a Hungarian postage stamp, postmark, printed publisher information, and handwritten Hungarian text and address lines.
